Install tmap package if not installed

## Choropleth
Choropleth of Singapore Map with Plan Area Name

```{r}
## Install and load necessary packages
packages = c('sf', 'tmap', 'tidyverse')
for (p in packages){
  if(!require(p, character.only = TRUE)){
    install.packages(p)
  }
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Read and process shapefile
shapefile_path <- "data/geospatial/MP14_PLNG_AREA_NO_SEA_PL.shp"
singapore_map <- st_read(shapefile_path)
singapore_map$geometry <- st_make_valid(singapore_map$geometry)
singapore_map <- singapore_map |>
  mutate(PLN_AREA_N = ifelse(grepl("Islands|Catchment", PLN_AREA_N, ignore.case = TRUE), "", PLN_AREA_N))

# Read CSV data
csv_data_path <- "flatprice5_last3year.csv"
data <- read.csv(csv_data_path)

# Check if 'town' column exists and rename it to match shapefile
if ("town" %in% names(data)) {
  data <- data %>%
    rename(PLN_AREA_N = town)
} else {
  stop("The column 'town' does not exist in the CSV data.")
}

# Summarize the data to get average resale price for each town
data_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(PLN_AREA_N) %>%
  summarise(avg_resale_price = mean(resale_price, na.rm = TRUE))

# Ensure 'PLN_AREA_N' exists in both data frames before merging
if (!"PLN_AREA_N" %in% names(singapore_map)) {
  stop("The column 'PLN_AREA_N' does not exist in the shapefile data.")
}

# Merge the summarized data with the shapefile data
singapore_map <- singapore_map %>%
  left_join(data_summary, by = "PLN_AREA_N")

# Check if the merge was successful
if (nrow(singapore_map) == 0) {
  stop("The merge resulted in an empty data frame. Please check the input data.")
}

# Check for NA values in 'PLN_AREA_N'
print(sum(is.na(singapore_map$PLN_AREA_N)))

# Verify merged data
print(head(singapore_map))
str(singapore_map)

# Set the tmap mode
tmap_mode("plot")

# Plot the map with labels
singapore_map_plot <- tm_shape(singapore_map) +
  tm_polygons(col = "avg_resale_price", palette = "Blues", title = "Avg Resale Price") +
  tm_text("PLN_AREA_N", size = 0.5, col = "black", shadow = TRUE, root = 4) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Map of Singapore Planning Areas", main.title.position = "center")

# Print the map object
print(singapore_map_plot)


```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(cartogram)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(repr)
library(viridis)

# Install and load necessary packages
packages = c('sf', 'tmap', 'tidyverse', 'cartogram')
for (p in packages){
  if(!require(p, character.only = TRUE)){
    install.packages(p)
  }
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Read and process shapefile
shapefile_path <- "data/geospatial/MP14_PLNG_AREA_NO_SEA_PL.shp"
singapore_map <- st_read(shapefile_path)
singapore_map$geometry <- st_make_valid(singapore_map$geometry)
singapore_map <- singapore_map %>%
  mutate(PLN_AREA_N = ifelse(grepl("Islands|Catchment", PLN_AREA_N, ignore.case = TRUE), "", PLN_AREA_N))

# Read CSV data
csv_data_path <- "flatprice5_last3year.csv"
data <- read.csv(csv_data_path)

# Check if 'town' column exists and rename it to match shapefile
if ("town" %in% names(data)) {
  data <- data %>%
    rename(PLN_AREA_N = town)
} else {
  stop("The column 'town' does not exist in the CSV data.")
}

# Summarize the data to get average resale price for each town
data_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(PLN_AREA_N) %>%
  summarise(avg_resale_price = mean(resale_price, na.rm = TRUE))

# Ensure 'PLN_AREA_N' exists in both data frames before merging
if (!"PLN_AREA_N" %in% names(singapore_map)) {
  stop("The column 'PLN_AREA_N' does not exist in the shapefile data.")
}

# Merge the summarized data with the shapefile data
singapore_map <- singapore_map %>%
  left_join(data_summary, by = "PLN_AREA_N")

# Check if the merge was successful
if (nrow(singapore_map) == 0) {
  stop("The merge resulted in an empty data frame. Please check the input data.")
}

# Check for NA values in 'PLN_AREA_N'
print(sum(is.na(singapore_map$PLN_AREA_N)))

# Verify merged data
print(head(singapore_map))
str(singapore_map)

# Fill NA values in avg_resale_price with a default value (0)
singapore_map$avg_resale_price[is.na(singapore_map$avg_resale_price)] <- 100000

# Create the cartogram
singapore_cartogram <- cartogram_cont(singapore_map, "avg_resale_price", itermax = 10)

singapore_cartogram_filtered <- singapore_cartogram %>%
  filter(avg_resale_price != 100000)

# Set the tmap mode
tmap_mode("plot")

# Plot the cartogram with labels
singapore_cartogram_plot <- tm_shape(singapore_cartogram_filtered) +
  tm_polygons(col = "avg_resale_price", palette = "Blues", title = "Avg Resale Price") +
  tm_text("PLN_AREA_N", size = 0.5, col = "black", shadow = TRUE, root = 4) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Cartogram of Singapore Planning Areas", main.title.position = "center")

# Print the map object
print(singapore_cartogram_plot)
```
